days.title: Day 1 - Delhi Arrival – Haridwar/Rishikesh
activities: Meet and greet with our representative.
In the evening, attend Ganga Aarti.

days.title: Day 2 – Haridwar/Rishikesh to Joshimath/Pipalkoti
activities: Early morning breakfast and check out.
En route, witness the Himalayan landscapes and river valleys.
Visit Devprayag, subject to time availability.
Visit Rudraprayag, subject to time availability.

days.title: Day 3 – Joshimath/Pipalkoti to Badrinath
activities: Early morning breakfast and check out.
Arrive and check in to the hotel.
Take a holy bath at Tapt Kund, subject to conditions and temple guidelines.
Proceed for darshan at Shri Badrinath Temple.
Attend evening Aarti, subject to timing.

days.title: Day 4 – Badrinath to Mana to Rudraprayag/Srinagar
activities: Early morning darshan at Shri Badrinath Temple.
Return to the hotel for breakfast.
Visit Mata Murti Temple, subject to time availability.

days.title: Day 5 – Rudraprayag/Srinagar to Rishikesh to Delhi
activities: Early morning breakfast and check out.
Visit Ram Jhula or Laxman Jhula area, subject to time availability.
Drop at Delhi Airport/Railway Station for onward journey.
